description: This file contains implementations for URL escaping and unescaping functions used in libcurl. It defines functions such as curl_easy_escape, curl_unescape, and helper functions for URL encoding/decoding, along with related utility functions.

methods.name: char * curl_escape(const char * string,int inlength)
methods.description: Convenience function to escape URL string, calls curl_easy_escape with NULL data.

methods.name: char * curl_unescape(const char * string,int length)
methods.description: Convenience function to unescape URL string, calls curl_easy_unescape with NULL data.

methods.name: char * curl_easy_escape(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * string,int inlength)
methods.description: Escapes an unescaped string for URL transmission, returning a newly allocated string.

methods.name: curl_urldecode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string, returning a malloced string and its length.

methods.name: char * curl_easy_unescape(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * string,int length,int * olen)
methods.description: Unescapes a URL-encoded string, returning a malloced string.

methods.name: void curl_free(void * p)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by libcurl functions.

methods.name: void Curl_hexencode(const unsigned char * src,size_t len,unsigned char * out,size_t olen)
methods.description: Converts binary data to lowercase hex string.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_urldecode(const char * string,size_t length,char ** ostring,size_t * olen,enum urlreject ctrl)

ctags.name: Curl_hexencode
ctags.pattern: /^void Curl_hexencode(const unsigned char *src, size_t len, \/* input length *\/$/
ctags.signature: (const unsigned char * src,size_t len,unsigned char * out,size_t olen)

ctags.name: Curl_urldecode
ctags.signature: (const char * string,size_t length,char ** ostring,size_t * olen,enum urlreject ctrl)

ctags.name: curl_easy_unescape
ctags.signature: (struct Curl_easy * data,const char * string,int length,int * olen)
